simple.meaning: חָבֵר (châbêr) is a Hebrew object word meaning “an associate.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Judges 20:11. The surrounding context includes family, city, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָבֵר (H2270) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: חָבֵר (châbêr) / H2270 is traced through Judges 20:11, Psalms 45:8, Psalms 119:63, Proverbs 28:24 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H2270. chaber חָבֵר adjective and noun masculine Song of Solomon 8:13 united, associate, companion — ׳ח absolute Prov 28:24 ; Psa 119:68 ; suffix חֲבֵרוֺ Eccl 4:10 (+ 3 t. Ezekiel Kt; Qr חבריו see below); plural חֲבֵרִים Judg 20:11 ; Song 8:13 construct חַבְרֵי Isa 1:23 ; suffix חֲבֵרֶ֑ךָ Psa 45:8 , חֲבֵרֶ֑יךָ Song 1:7 ; חֲבֵרָיו Isa 44:11 3 t.; Ezekiel Qr; — 1 adjective united חֲבֵרִים אֶחָד כְּאִישׁ Judg 20:11 knit together as one man (AV RV). 2. n. associate, fellow: a. of children (tribes) of Israel assoc. with Judah as head Ezek 37:16 ; id. associated with Joseph (Ehpraimitic source) as head 37:16 ; 37:19 (in all these read Qr חֲבֵרָיו ). b. of like rank Psa 45:8 c. of like calling Song 1:7 . d. worshippers (associates, belonging to the society or guild) of idols Isa 44:11 (see Che; > others priests , Geig umschr. 121 493 SS, compare חֶבֶר Hosea 6:9 ; Du reads חֲבָרִים enchantments ). e. in General Song 8:13 . f. implying likeness of character Isa 1:23 ; Prov 28:24 ; Psa 119:63 . 3 companion at a particular time Eccl 4:10 .
